typography.setup_instructions: Import fonts using standard CSS @import from Google Fonts.

layout_and_spacing.marketplace_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4 md:gap-6

skin_card.structure: Flat surface, sharp edges (rounded-sm), 1px subtle border.
skin_card.visual: Dark gray background (#121212). The bottom edge MUST have a 3px to 4px solid border matching the skin's rarity color.
skin_card.hover_state: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color glow (drop-shadow using rarity color), background lightens slightly to #1C1C1C.
skin_card.image_container: Aspect ratio 4:3, pure black or dark radial gradient background to make the skin pop.

buttons.primary: bg-[#E4AE39] text-[#0A0A0A] font-bold rounded-sm px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#F5C75A] transition-colors
buttons.steam_login: bg-[#171A21] text-[#E0E0E0] border border-[#2A475E] rounded-sm px-6 py-3 flex items-center gap-3 hover:bg-[#2A475E] transition-colors

navigation.style: Crystal Glass variant: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 sticky top-0 z-50
navigation.layout: Flex justify-between, items-center, h-16 or h-20. Steam login on the right.

filters_sidebar.style: Sticky left column, transparent background, text-[#E0E0E0], custom checkboxes with rarity colors.

motion_and_interactions.modals: backdrop-blur-md for the overlay, sharp modal dialog with 1px border-white/10

hero_background.usage: Use with a heavy black overlay (e.g., bg-black/60 to bg-black/80) to ensure text remains perfectly legible.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use the placeholder_skins URLs for rendering mock CS2 skins in the marketplace and inventory grids. DO NOT use generic placeholders like via.placeholder.com. Ensure you are writing .js files, NOT .tsx files. Use react-icons/fa for the Steam icon (FaSteam).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Do not use pure white text; use #E0E0E0. Rarity text must have text-shadow if placed over light backgrounds.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute using kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='steam-login-button').
